name: Confirmation
purpose: The end-of-flow success screen: a success-solid glyph, a heading, a short message and the next actions. Confirms an action completed (payment sent, request submitted). A layout/composition that reuses the Button atom. Surfaced as a missing pattern by the journey gap report.

props.name: title
props.$note: What completed, in plain words (e.g. 'Payment sent') — carries the success meaning, not the icon colour.

props.name: actions
props.$note: 1 primary (e.g. Done) + optional ghost (e.g. View receipt).

tokens.$icon-note: success-solid glyph: the tick is a cutout, so it shows the page colour behind (white tick on light, dark tick on dark). REVIEW: confirm the dark-mode tick reads acceptably or add a backing.

livesInside: End of a payment / transfer / application flow

behaviour: Passive panel — no states of its own; the Button atom inside carries hover/pressed/focus. Full-width actions, so buttons use press-only physics (no hover-grow).

motion.entrance: success-solid pops in (scale .5 → 1.06 → 1, spring easing) then title / message / actions rise (translateY 10→0 + fade), staggered 140 / 220 / 300ms.
motion.reducedMotion: all entrance animation disabled under prefers-reduced-motion — content is shown immediately.

responsive.mobile: vertically centred in the viewport (min-height:100dvh + justify-content:center) at ≤480px
responsive.$desktop-todo: REVIEW: a DESKTOP variant is still needed (wider / dialog-style layout, not full-bleed centred). Logged in _COMPONENT-GAPS.md (Dave, 2026-06-30).

accessibility.role: role='group' with aria-labelledby pointing at the title, so the panel is announced as a unit.
accessibility.colourIndependence: success is carried by the HEADING TEXT, not the green icon (icon is aria-hidden) — meaning never depends on colour (1.4.1).
accessibility.screenReader: REVIEW (inferred): confirm the message reads naturally after the title; consider whether the success should be announced via a live region when it appears mid-flow.

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): conveying success by the green icon alone — the heading text must state what happened (1.4.1).
REVIEW (inferred): two primary (red) buttons — one primary action; secondaries are ghost.
REVIEW (inferred): auto-dismissing the confirmation before the user has read/acted on it.
REVIEW (inferred): rounding the panel or buttons — brand is square/angular.
REVIEW (inferred): UPPERCASE heading or message — house type rule is sentence case.

tokenValidation.against: canon token store (semantic-colour.json); declared values match in light + dark (passes _validate_snippets). success-solid byte-matches assets/icons/status-icons.
tokenValidation.result: PASS (colour + icon); 1 OPEN question (dark-mode tick cutout).

provenance.$note: REVIEW: no Figma node yet — surfaced by the journey gap report. Needs a design owner + Figma source before promotion from candidate to gated.
